description: Project K16xN32 INT8 Macro, four resident weight contexts. II is not first-result latency.

banks_per_context.conditions: 16 physical banks/context; bank corresponds to an N output position in native INT16 organization.

subarrays_per_bank.conditions: 16 sub-arrays/bank; sub-array corresponds to one K element.

columns_per_subarray.conditions: 16 bit columns/sub-array; physical columns do not change under INT8 splitting. Existing bit unit describes stored weight-bit width; this is also a count of 16 bit-columns.

weight_contexts.conditions: The finalized project design states 4 resident 512-byte contexts per Macro (2 KiB total); earlier section 3.1 calls four an adjustable example.

weight_bits.source_version: commit 7383ae43cefcddc04d01c189794356ca62eb7101; git-blob acf4798e3d0a5ed57bec576849d6c3ffb4679ab7; 3.1 INT8 x INT8 row; lines 149-155
weight_bits.conditions: INT8 profile selects eight-bit weight; physical 16-column sub-array splits into two weights.

activation_bits.source_version: commit 7383ae43cefcddc04d01c189794356ca62eb7101; git-blob acf4798e3d0a5ed57bec576849d6c3ffb4679ab7; 3.1 INT8 x INT8 row; lines 149-155
activation_bits.conditions: INT8 profile selects eight-bit activation; bit-serial input is one activation bit per cycle.

accumulator_bits.source_version: commit 7383ae43cefcddc04d01c189794356ca62eb7101; git-blob acf4798e3d0a5ed57bec576849d6c3ffb4679ab7; 3.1 INT8 x INT8 row; lines 149-155
accumulator_bits.conditions: INT8 mode has 32-bit output per result. Do not substitute the 64-bit mantissa path described for FP/BFP processing.

input_ii_cycles.source_version: commit 7383ae43cefcddc04d01c189794356ca62eb7101; git-blob acf4798e3d0a5ed57bec576849d6c3ffb4679ab7; 3.1 INT8 x INT8 row; lines 149-155
input_ii_cycles.conditions: Effective INT8 Macro input initiation interval is 8 cycles; not first-result latency.

write_wordline_bytes.source_version: commit 7383ae43cefcddc04d01c189794356ca62eb7101; git-blob acf4798e3d0a5ed57bec576849d6c3ffb4679ab7; 3.3.4 final LW rotation; lines 421-439
write_wordline_bytes.conditions: The L=16 write organization explicitly sets 32 bytes per Macro wordline; final LW schedule writes one wordline to each Macro in two Cores per Plane per SL. This is a documented project design choice, not silicon-verified write timing.

compute_first_cycles.conditions: II=8 is the steady-state initiation interval, not the pipelined first-result latency. No calibrated Macro first-result latency supplied.

write_first_cycles.conditions: Wordline width and architectural LW issue pattern are documented; macro SRAM programming first-result latency is not supplied.

write_wordline_ii_cycles.conditions: The schedule revisits each Macro once per 10-cycle rotation; neither that service interval nor per-cycle system issue proves the physical per-Macro write initiation interval.

context_switch_cycles.conditions: Core active-context selection occurs one cycle after its final old-context ACC drains. This scheduling relation is not an independently calibrated isolated-Macro switch latency.
